findings.title: Hero panel sits too wide-left, breaking the centered mass of the reference
findings.reference: The dark content panel is inset ~15% from the left within the full-bleed photo hero, roughly one-third in, so the photo breathes to the left of the panel and the composition reads centered-left.
findings.candidate: The panel hugs the very left container edge with no breathing room, and its H1 spans nearly the full panel width, making the hero read left-locked rather than centered-left.
findings.direction: In the hero, add ~48–64px left inset to the panel (e.g. padding-left: 56px inside the 1200px container, or margin-left: 4vw) and cap H1 max-width to ~15ch so line breaks land like the reference; keep the brand pill, paragraphs, CTA and availability badge order intact.

findings.title: Services flagship split card lost its horizontal 3-col anatomy
findings.reference: The full-width flagship card is a horizontal split: icon tile on the far left, title+copy in a middle column, and CTA buttons on the right, all on one row.
findings.candidate: The flagship card renders as stacked blocks (icon tile above title/copy, CTAs below), reading as a vertical card rather than the horizontal split signature.
findings.direction: Rebuild the flagship card as a 3-column flex/grid row (icon tile 96px | copy block flex-1 | CTA column right-aligned) with vertical centering and 32px column gap; at <640px allow it to stack, but desktop must be horizontal.

findings.title: Testimonial quote glyphs and carousel dots are missing
findings.reference: Each white testimonial card carries a large translucent quote glyph in the bottom-right corner, and carousel dots sit centered beneath the two cards.
findings.candidate: Both cards omit the quote glyph entirely and there are no carousel dots under the card pair, flattening the signature detail of the testimonial band.
findings.direction: Add a 48px quote glyph at rgba(255,255,255,.35) positioned bottom-right inside each card, and render 3–4 small carousel dots (active one white, others white/40%) centered below the two cards.

findings.title: Marquee band is too tall and reads as a bright banner
findings.reference: The violet logo band is slim (~56–64px), fully saturated violet with small white wordmarks, sitting as a quiet divider between about and services.
findings.candidate: The band is noticeably taller and lighter violet, with larger, brighter wordmark chips that pull more attention than the reference divider.
findings.direction: Cap the marquee band height at 64px (px-0 py-4), deepen bg to #6D28D9, render wordmarks as 13–14px white/70% text wordmarks (no chip boxes) with ~56px gaps, and ensure the hover-pause marquee stays within the 64px bound.

findings.title: Section rhythm between Why Us and FAQ is looser than the reference
findings.reference: Sections sit on consistent ~96px vertical padding with tight internal gaps between the why-us split, FAQ split and newsletter, keeping the page dense and rhythmic.
findings.candidate: Padding around the Why Us and FAQ blocks is slightly larger and the newsletter band gains extra top spacing, making the lower half of the page feel airier and less rhythmic than the reference.
findings.direction: Normalize section vertical padding to 96px desktop (64px mobile) across Why Us, FAQ and Newsletter, and reduce the gap between FAQ bottom and newsletter hairline to 0 (hairline-separated bands), so the alternating surface rhythm matches the reference density.

visual.summary: The candidate is a strong realization of the RankForge Kenya blueprint and clearly reads as the same design as the reference: photographic hero with dark rounded panel, violet pill CTA and availability badge; pale-lilac about band with duotone photo tile; icon-chip service cards with ghost pills; why-us split with two floating metric cards; violet-bar FAQ accordion beside an illustration card; duotone photographic testimonial band with white quote cards and star rows; violet newsletter band with 2-up name inputs; and the black CTA block with violet ribbon, floating white contact strip and 4-column footer. Typography (Poppins/Inter, 700–800 weights, tight line-heights), token palette, card radii/hairlines/soft shadows and component language all match closely. Main deductions: the hero panel is locked to the left edge instead of inset like the reference; the services flagship card lost its horizontal 3-column anatomy; testimonial cards are missing the translucent quote glyphs and carousel dots; the violet marquee band is taller and brighter than the slim 64px divider; and lower-page section spacing is slightly looser than the reference rhythm. No anti-pattern violations detected — no white hero, no template SaaS styling, no reference brand reproduction. Fix the hero panel inset, restore the flagship card's horizontal split and the testimonial quote glyph/dots, tighten the marquee band, and normalize section padding to close the remaining gaps.
